tasks.label: bettbox: ensure dev core
args: exec dart ./setup.dart "$(flutter devices --machine 2>/dev/null | jq -r --arg id "${command:flutter.getSelectedDeviceId}" '.[] | select(.id == $id).targetPlatform' | sed 's/-.*//;s/darwin/macos/')" --out core --dev --ensure

$id = "${command:flutter.getSelectedDeviceId}"; $tp = $null; $lines = (flutter devices --machine) 2>&1; foreach ($line in $lines) { if ($line -match ('"id":"' + [regex]::Escape($id) + '"')) { $m = [regex]::Match($line, '"targetPlatform":"([^"]*)"'); if ($m.Success) { $tp = $m.Groups[1].Value; break } } }; if (-not $tp) { exit 1 }; $tp = $tp -replace '-.*$',''; & dart ./setup.dart $tp --out core --dev --ensure
